conventions.consent: Interview, GPS, photography and audio are separate choices; no project commitment.
conventions.appliance_inventory: C_loads accepts named-v1 cards with appliance/name and the original numeric/use fields, as well as older fixed-position arrays. Named entries identify their own appliance category; older entries are identified by their index in the questionnaire rows. Time dropdown codes use M/A/E/N combinations. Earlier valid time strings are preserved.
conventions.inventory_photos: C_loads and D_equipment rows may include a photo descriptor (id, mime, size, width, height). Photos are optional, require separate photo consent, sync with the interview, and are served only through authenticated interview photo endpoints. Image bytes are excluded from ordinary JSON/CSV exports.
conventions.business_equipment: D_equipment is a variable-length array of up to 100 equipment cards with the original name, qty, power, hours, months, fuel and output fields. Earlier fixed-position arrays remain supported.

sections.help: Interview the barangay captain or a designated official, and separately the head of each community facility. Use records where available (barangay profile, school and health-station inventories, hazard maps). In barangays with ICC/IP communities, also interview the Indigenous Peoples Mandatory Representative (IPMR) as a key informant and, separately, the recognised customary leaders of the Indigenous Political Structure. The IPMR’s formal governance role is different from the customary authority of the Indigenous Political Structure and from the rights of affected community members.

questions.help: Separate critical-circuit demand from whole-facility consumption. B = bill; N = nameplate; G = generator rating; M = measured; E = respondent estimate.

questions.help: Add a named table for each school, health facility, water system, evacuation centre and communication facility. Include pumping, emergency lighting, refrigeration, communications and essential medical equipment. Five equipment rows per facility. Add another named table if more rows are needed.

sections.help: Complete one row per facility. Record the hours that supply is essential, not only the hours the facility is open. questions.help: Complete once per community at end of fieldwork. Record dimensions, area (m²), slope, shading, exposure, access, equipment condition, engineering verification and settlement suitability. Preliminary observations do not replace engineering surveys. The photo row records whether consented photos were taken; this app does not capture or upload photos/audio.

metadata.respondent: For new interviews: automatically generated username-HE/CI/SO-sequence (minimum 3 digits). Existing manual references remain unchanged.
metadata.community: Administrator-assigned barangay, saved when the interview starts.
metadata.municipality_province: Administrator-assigned municipality/province, saved when the interview starts.
metadata.language: Administrator-assigned interview language(s), saved when the interview starts; not a verified translation or independent check of the language actually spoken.
metadata.started_at: Device timestamp with timezone; submitting enumerator is assigned from the authenticated account
metadata.photo_consent: Separate photo permission Yes/No; Not asked for earlier interviews
metadata.audio_consent: Separate audio permission Yes/No; Not asked for earlier interviews
metadata.sampling_frame: Sampling-frame/list reference, not a household-name list
metadata.replacement: Was this a replacement of a selected household? Yes/No
metadata.version: Questionnaire version; earlier interviews are not relabeled
metadata.reference_mode: allocated-v1 for newly generated references; manual for existing/older interviews.
metadata.reference_sequence: Per-enumerator, per-instrument number consumed when a new interview starts; not reused after local deletion or server deletion.
metadata.reference_allocation_id: Server reservation that permits this phone to allocate numbers offline.
metadata.assignment_version: Administrator assignment snapshot used when this interview started; separate from questionnaire version and offline app-cache version.

privacy: Exact GPS is stored separately and available only through an administrator endpoint. Standard exports use a 0.01-degree approximate grid. Names/contact details in key-informant answers remain confidential research data.
